source: 2026-06, 2026-07, and 2026-08 have full category breakdowns pulled live via Facebook Ads MCP (2026-06 and 2026-07 = full closed months as of 2026-08-12, 2026-08 = month-to-date, re-pulled 2026-08-25 for 1-25 Aug to match the RAW_TX transaction-data extension pulled the same day via the M365 pipeline — replaces an earlier 1-12 Aug partial pull). 2026-08 nose_open = Nose Open 01 + 02 accounts only (excludes the dedicated Inter account, same as July); inter = the dedicated Inter account (renamed from Nose Open 03, ฿63,701.16 for 1-25 Aug) plus 2 legacy campaigns still named "[INTER]" inside Nose Open 02 (฿5,169.32) — those legacy campaigns' spend is already inside the nose_open total below, so 'total' sums the 5 nose/semi/breast/brow accounts + the dedicated Inter account only, not the category fields (they don't sum to 'total' by design, see 2026-07 note below). 'inter' = sum of campaigns with "Inter" in the name inside the Nose Open 02 ad account (confirmed with the team on 2026-07-12), not a whole ad account; because those campaigns are also inside nose_open, the month 'total' is the sum of the 6 ad accounts (no inter double-count) rather than the sum of the category fields. The 2026-07 figures below replace an earlier month-to-date-only pull (1-27 Jul) taken on 2026-07-27; the 'inter' total moved from 24857 to 21980 between the two pulls, which is within Meta's normal post-hoc attribution/delivery adjustment range for a period that was still in progress at the first pull. Months with only a 'total' field are carried over from previous manual pulls until the scheduled workflow backfills them. Re-verified 2026-07's 6-account total against live Facebook Ads MCP account-level insights on 2026-08-13: matches to the baht (1550958), confirming account-level totals already include spend from deleted campaigns (Meta keeps that in the aggregate even though deleted campaigns no longer appear in campaign-list queries). The 'inter' split specifically is built by name-matching campaigns inside Nose Open 02, which CANNOT see deleted campaigns (confirmed: that account's campaign-level listing sums to ~42.7k THB less than its account-level total for July, and none of the visible campaigns are marked DELETED) — so if any deleted campaign had "Inter" in its name, that spend is misattributed to nose_open instead of inter in the category breakdown below. The month 'total' figures are unaffected by this (computed at account level, not from the campaign list), only the nose_open/inter split within a total could be off by an unknown amount up to ~42.7k for July. UPDATE 2026-08-13: the team supplied a corrected 2026-07 'total' of 1,673,928.18 THB (rounded to 1673928) sourced from their own report covering all campaigns across all 6 accounts including closed/deleted ones, replacing the 1,550,958 account-level API total above — the gap (~123k) is presumably additional deleted-campaign spend the account-level API pull itself didn't fully surface, beyond what was already traced to Nose Open 02. The category breakdown (nose_open/nose_semi/breast_lipo/brow_hairline/inter) fields were NOT adjusted since there's no way to attribute the extra ~123k to a specific category from available data — they no longer sum to 'total' as a result; 'total' is the authoritative July ad-spend figure, the category fields are a partial breakdown of it.
